attribution_text: 出典：国土交通省 Project PLATEAU（3D都市モデル）を加工して作成（建物の基部を地表面の高さにそろえて表示）
notes: Decision: station lead, GitHub #39 comment 6324045059. Reference origin = stations/shinjuku/gteki/station.json origin (35.687, 139.6994, JGD2011 EPSG:6668, ENU, h 0; hM null on purpose), the same GRS80 geodetic -> ECEF -> ENU as Ikebukuro at that origin; frame shinjuku-station-enu-v0 is horizontal-only (vertical_mode per_feature_ground, from `gis station-frame shinjuku --vertical per_feature_ground`). No vertical datum: each building is flattened to symbolic street z = 0 by subtracting its own ground height (z_local = z_TP - groundHeight(building)); groundHeight is the building's own CityGML ground-height attribute if it carries one of ground_height_attributes (none is configured: the PLATEAU 2025 Shinjuku bldg files 53394525/53394526 carry no such attribute, and the uro 3.2 schema defines none on bldg:Building), else, for buildings, by priority: (2) when LOD2 is drawn and the building has bldg:GroundSurface polygons, their minimum z (basis ground_surface_lod2; their max-min spread is recorded per building), so a sunken entrance or light well in the walls cannot pull the base down; (3) the minimum z of the lod1Solid even when LOD2 is drawn (lod1_solid_bottom); (4) the minimum z of the LOD drawn (min_z_of_drawn_lod); roads keep (4). Never one constant for all buildings; the receipt records the basis of every building, the count per basis and the min/median/max subtracted offset, and, per window POI (poi:exit:1..4), the count, min/median/max subtracted ground height and gml_ids of the buildings whose footprint bbox lies within exit_neighbour_radius_m (30 m) of its connector node, so the mismatch at the exit tops can be judged. Window = union of 300 m discs around the connector nodes (graph.json) of POIs poi:exit:1..4 only (ground-level exits, pois.json connectorNodeIds); exits 5 and 6 reach only B1 and are excluded; there is no origin disc (r_origin_m 0 adds none); a configured POI id that is missing, or has no resolvable connector node, fails the run. The window touches 3rd-level meshes 53394525, 53394526, 53394535 and 53394536 (with the 50 m mesh_margin_m for features that straddle a mesh edge); a missing or unacquired mesh fails the run. 53394535 and 53394536 are listed in sources.yaml with expected_bytes null and are NOT YET ACQUIRED. Default kinds = ["bldg"]: Shinjuku's own surface layer already draws roads, and PLATEAU tran is on rights HOLD (#39); tran is optional via --kinds and, when requested, flattens roads per feature the same way. Visual-only context (gteki_role context, NOT_FOR_ROUTING); textures are not converted.
